text.feels_intro: How {name}'s electrical burns feel right now; let this shape {his} tone, posture and movement:
text.feels_outro: Answer must be creative and different, repetition will be punished.

head: {name}'s face: a faint red, branching mark, with singed hair standing on end. A sharp smell of ozone and singed hair clings to {him}.
{name}'s face: red, branching burn marks across the cheek and temple, the skin blistered. {name} smells of ozone and scorched skin.
{name}'s face: deep, black-edged burn marks branching across {his} face, the skin split and smoking. The acrid stench of burnt hair and flesh hangs about {him}.
body: {name}'s back: a faint red, branching mark through the clothing. A faint whiff of ozone hangs about {him}.
{name}'s back: red, branching burn marks, blistered and scorched through the clothing. {name} smells of ozone and scorched cloth.
{name}'s back: deep, black-edged burn marks branching across {his} back; the clothing smolders. {name} reeks of burnt cloth and seared flesh.
arm: {name}'s {part}: a faint red, branching mark; the hand twitches. It carries a faint, sharp smell of ozone.
{name}'s {part}: red, branching burn marks, blistered; the fingers curl and tremble. It smells of ozone and scorched skin.
{name}'s {part}: deep, black-edged burn marks; the arm trembles and the hand is clenched like a claw. It gives off an acrid smell of burnt flesh.
leg: {name}'s {part}: a faint red, branching mark; the muscle twitches. A faint smell of ozone clings to {him}.
{name}'s {part}: red, branching burn marks, blistered; the muscle trembles. It smells sharply of ozone and singed skin.
{name}'s {part}: deep, black-edged burn marks; the leg trembles and spasms. An acrid stench of seared flesh rises from it.

head: {name}'s face tingles and buzzes and {his} ears ring. {name} is jumpy and blinks hard.
{name}'s face burns and twitches, {his} teeth aching from the current. {name} is shaken and stammering.
{name}'s face is white-hot agony and numb in patches, {his} vision flashing. {name} is dazed and barely coherent.
body: {name}'s back tingles and buzzes, the muscles twitching. {name} is jumpy and tense.
{name}'s back burns and clenches in spasms. {name} is stiff and shaky and breathes in jerks.
{name}'s back is white-hot agony and the muscles will not stop convulsing. {name} is dazed and close to collapse.
arm: {name}'s {part} tingles and buzzes, the fingers twitching. {name} shakes it out.
{name}'s {part} burns and spasms, the grip failing. {name} cradles it, trembling.
{name}'s {part} is white-hot agony and numb in patches; the hand will not open. {name} is shocked and speechless.
leg: {name}'s {part} tingles and buzzes, the muscle twitching. {name} shakes it out as {he} walks.
{name}'s {part} burns and spasms with every step. {name} stumbles and limps.
{name}'s {part} is white-hot agony and will not hold weight, jerking in spasms. {name} collapses or needs support.

levels: , a sudden crack of current. The jolt throws {his} muscles into a spasm, and {he} jerks with a yelp. The air smells sharply of ozone.
through muscles that are already jangling. The current arcs through the burn, and {he} convulses as the pain flares. The smell of ozone and singed hair rises.
, and the lightning arcs through the burns. The pain is blinding and {he} locks up in a spasm, hair standing on end and breath gone. The acrid stench of burnt flesh fills the air.
, and it is too much. The current floods {him}; {he} convulses, smoking, then goes slack, {his} heart stuttering.
